question: Is there an open SCF RFP for developer tooling or indexing infrastructure I could build against?

golden.answer:
No matching open brief is listed per the official SCF RFP Track page as of 2026-11-05. As of 2026-11-05, the official RFP Track page lists no open brief and says "October 2026: New Q4 RFPs are coming soon." Scout now agrees: open=0, activeQuarter=q4-2026, both former Q3 briefs closed. Its separate synthetic scf-round-46 row describes the Submission window through 2026-11-09; it is not an RFP brief. An RFP Track submission must address an open brief from the current quarter. Applicants start with the rolling interest form and submit a full proposal only if invited. An open brief does not guarantee eligibility or an invitation.

The dated example is illustrative. A later answer must report the roster and round state supported then.
